# Happy places

Happy places are calm serene locatiosn E.M. Gemovich thinks about when she is stressed.
For the investigator's these act as safe places they can safely have a short rest at (regaining their HP).

However, they become slowly and unnoticeably corrupted through the runs.
The fifth run they are entered they are changed into their corrupted form.
After that run they become a lapse as Gemovich no longer treasures the happy place and forfeits it.

When the investigators discover a new Happy place roll a d6 to determine which of the below Happy places it is.
If it is a repeat of a happy place that has already been discovered either reroll to you get a new result or ask the investigators for a happy place from one of their characters that has become embroiled in this clash of mind and entity.
